verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing's own docs say it supports custom pricing plans and several usage-based pricing models, and a community source confirms per-user, per-usage, and per-tier subscription models. Usage is metered through the Billing Meters API and meter events, which a developer has to integrate, so the 'without custom code' part is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of volume vs. graduated tiering, hybrid subscription-plus-usage configuration, credits, commitments, overage handling, and no-code (Dashboard) setup of these pricing models.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can price with tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, and hybrid subscription-plus-usage models — including credits, commitments, and overage — without custom code

citations.quote: you can set up and integrate different types of usage-based pricing models with your SaaS product.
Stripe Billing supports per-user, per-usage, and per-tier subscription models in an automated recurring billing fashion
You can use meter events to bill a customer based on their usage.
